name: Sickle of Hours
description: A reaping hook whose edge is worn thin by too many harvests.
benefit: Each cut ages the wounded foe, so slow enemies fall to a few strokes.
cost: Every swing also ages the bearer by a breath they do not get back.

name: Thread-Spear of the Maze
description: A spear with a spool of red wool bound under the head.
benefit: Thrusts pay out a thread that always leads back to the last safe place.
cost: The thread snags on doors and bystanders and cannot be cut.

name: Snapped-Chain Flail
description: Three links of a titan's fetter hung from a bone haft.
benefit: Strikes break wards, bonds and shackles on whatever they hit.
cost: It also breaks the bearer's own oaths and bindings without warning.

name: Hecatomb Cleaver
description: A broad butcher's blade stained brown to the tang.
benefit: Cuts through armour as if it were a carcass hung for the altar.
cost: It must be fed a living offering each dawn or it dulls.

name: Seer's Foretold Dart
description: A throwing dart fletched with a blind man's grey hair.
benefit: Never misses a target the bearer has dreamed of the night before.
cost: Dreams come only when the bearer sleeps in a strange place.

name: Hourglass Buckler
description: A round shield with a sealed glass of black sand set in the boss.
benefit: Raising it slows the blow of the first attacker to a crawl.
cost: Once the sand runs out the shield is a plain disc until it is turned over.

name: Threshold Ward
description: A slab of doorstone carried on the arm like a sanctuary in miniature.
benefit: Foes will not strike across it, and allies behind it are left alone.
cost: The bearer must never be the first to attack while holding it.

name: Censer Shield
description: A hollow shield trailing smoke from burning resin.
benefit: Its smoke thins the sickness in the air for those standing close.
cost: The smoke blinds the bearer along with everyone else.

name: Funerary Screen
description: A wicker screen hung with the grave goods of the forgotten.
benefit: The restless dead hesitate to approach the bearer.
cost: Every grave good must be replaced at a barrow or the dead return in anger.

name: Veiled Lantern
description: A lantern of dark horn that sheds light only on hidden things.
benefit: Reveals secret doors, sigils and the unseen at close range.
cost: Ordinary sight fails while it is open, and the veil is sworn to silence.

name: Bull-Mask of the Maze
description: A horned helm cast in bronze, eyes worn smooth by long dark.
benefit: The bearer knows the way through any enclosed passage.
cost: The mask whispers, and sleep is difficult beneath it.

name: Seer's Blindfold
description: A strip of dyed wool worn tight across the eyes.
benefit: Shows the next blow a moment before it falls.
cost: Nothing else can be seen while it is worn.

name: Garland Crown
description: A wreath of ox-bone beads strung on bay leaf.
benefit: Beasts and sacred guardians treat the wearer as a bearer of offerings.
cost: Priests demand a tithe of any plunder the wearer carries.

name: Hood of the Silent Oracle
description: A grey cowl stitched shut over the mouth.
benefit: Spells and shouts cast at the wearer fall quiet before they land.
cost: The wearer cannot speak, trade or sing while it is on.

name: Stag Circlet
description: Antlers of a hind never taken, bound with white cord.
benefit: Wild beasts remain calm and the trail stays clear.
cost: The goddess has withdrawn, and every hunt the wearer joins sours.

name: Loosed Cuirass
description: Plate that hangs on the frame by straps no one remembers tying.
benefit: Cannot be pinned or grappled and slips free of nets and chains.
cost: Its plates rattle loose at a run and must be rebuckled often.

name: Threadbare Chiton of Years
description: A linen robe aged to gauze by decades in a single afternoon.
benefit: Wounds taken in it heal on their own given a short rest.
cost: Cloth and wearer both age faster than they should.

name: Pilgrim's Sanctuary Mantle
description: A white mantle sewn with the names of a hundred shrines.
benefit: While worn, sanctuary and rest are offered freely in every holy place.
cost: It stains at once in a place of violence and cannot be cleaned.

name: Plague-Doctor's Apron
description: A waxed apron stiff with years of sickroom work.
benefit: Disease and foul air pass over the wearer without taking hold.
cost: Townsfolk keep their distance and doors stay shut.

name: Oath-Bound Shirt
description: Mail whose rings were each closed over a spoken promise.
benefit: Each oath kept adds a ring of protection, up to a full coat.
cost: Breaking an oath tears the shirt and the bearer's wounds open.

name: Wool-Bound Sandals
description: Sandals wrapped in red wool from the knee to the toe.
benefit: Footsteps leave a trail only the wearer can follow home.
cost: Wool soaks up water and dries only in sunlight, which is rare below.

name: Waymaker's Foretold Boots
description: Boots that point to a road before the wearer has seen it.
benefit: Reveals the safest path and ambushes along it at a glance.
cost: The way shown is always the longest of the safe ones.

name: Gravewalker Greaves
description: Greaves of green bronze taken from an unmarked barrow.
benefit: The wearer walks over graves and boneyards without waking the dead.
cost: Wearing them in a settlement draws suspicion and refusal of service.

name: Sandals of the Slow Hour
description: Sandals soled with petrified wood from the first grove.
benefit: Slows the pace of the world for a few steps after each stumble.
cost: Slows the bearer too, whose own pace is always the longer.

name: Ash-Wading Boots
description: Greased leather boots caked with the ashes of a dead orchard.
benefit: Crosses blighted fields and ash drifts at full speed.
cost: The ash clings and marks the wearer as a bringer of famine.

name: Initiate's Ring-Gloves
description: Fine gloves with a signet sewn into each knuckle.
benefit: Opens sealed ritual doors and handles forbidden relics safely.
cost: Each use reveals a secret to the order, and the order keeps a ledger.

name: Breaker's Gauntlets
description: Iron gauntlets with the locks filed away.
benefit: Shatters shackles, locks and bindings with a closed fist.
cost: Cannot be removed without a smith, and no smith will take the work.

name: Bloodied Altar Wraps
description: Strips of altar cloth worn dark from the knife.
benefit: Strikes against beasts and sacrifices land with heavy force.
cost: The hands never wash clean, and the smell draws predators.

name: Pledge Mitts
description: Mittens tied at the wrist with a ribbon marked in a stranger's hand.
benefit: One promised favour may be called in and finished in a single move.
cost: The favour owed back is chosen by the creditor, not the wearer.

name: Smith's Orichalcum Gloves
description: Heavy gloves lined with fireclay and bright metal scale.
benefit: Handles hot metal and unstable relics without harm.
cost: The scale gives off a faint hum audible for some distance.

name: Cracked Hour-Bell
description: A tiny bell that rings an hour slightly wrong.
benefit: Once a day, rewinds a moment, undoing the last blow taken.
cost: The bell tolls loudly at the worst moments.

name: Blind Seer's Coin
description: A coin worn so smooth that both faces have gone.
benefit: Shows which of two paths or choices is the worse one.
cost: The coin takes a payment of memory each time it speaks.

name: Amulet of Rue
description: A silver sprig bound with a pinch of rue and salt.
benefit: Wards the bearer against sickness and curse for a night.
cost: The sprig withers by morning and must be replaced from a rare plant.

name: Unpaid Obol
description: A single coin pressed against the tongue of a corpse.
benefit: Spirits of the unburied will answer one question truthfully.
cost: The coin is owed back to the dead and the debt is called due at a bad time.

name: Boundary Pebble
description: A stone taken from the edge of a holy precinct.
benefit: Marks a single square of ground as a sanctuary for a short rest.
cost: If a blow is struck within the square, the stone cracks and the rest ends.

name: Spool of Ariadne's Thread
description: A spool of red wool that never seems to run out.
benefit: Allows a dungeon to be traced back to its entrance without a map.
cost: Anything caught in the thread is pulled tight and held.

name: Augur's Foretold Stylus
description: A bronze stylus engraved with a bird's wing.
benefit: Writes a single prediction on wax that comes true if left unread.
cost: Reading the prediction changes it, and always for the worse.

name: Votive Offering Knife
description: A narrow flint blade kept for the first cut.
benefit: Turns a slain beast into rich offerings that gods and priests will pay for.
cost: Each cut takes time and tools the field cannot spare.

name: Wax Tablet of the Silent
description: A blank wax tablet that takes marks only when pressed with a thumb.
benefit: Transmits a message to a listening oracle in perfect secrecy.
cost: Each message costs a day of conversation the bearer cannot get back.

name: Oarlock Lockpick Set
description: A rolled oilcloth of picks cut from broken oarlocks.
benefit: Opens harbour chests and ship's cabins without a key.
cost: The set fits only League locks and fails on all others.
